title: Editor becomes unusable, then hangs or crashes, on a project with 60,000+ sprite images
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.8.dev6, 4.7.2.stable, 4.7.1.stable

### System information

macOS 26.6.2 - Godot v4.7.2.stable.official [ed1daf0bf] - Metal 4.0 (Forward+) - integrated Apple M2 Pro - Apple M2 Pro (12 threads) - 16 GB

### Issue description

My game project has about 63,000 sprite images (animation frames). With it, the editor is barely usable:

- Opening the project takes an intolerably long time, and the editor stays sluggish afterwards.
- Navigating in the FileSystem dock is almost impossible: every time I unfold or collapse a folder, the editor stops responding for 10–20 seconds.
- A few minutes after opening the project, the editor freezes for good, or crashes, and the Output panel fills with errors.

This happens even when all the sprite folders are collapsed in the FileSystem dock and I don't touch anything. The editor seems to create thumbnails for every image in the project, including ones in folders I never open.

I expected a large number of images to make the editor slower to import, but not to make it hang or crash while I'm not doing anything.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Extract the MRP and run this once from the extracted folder. It creates 80,000 small PNG images in sprites/ (takes about 10 seconds):
godot --headless --path . -s generate_images.gd
2. Open the project in the editor and wait for the import to finish (about 5 minutes).
3. Keep the FileSystem dock as it is, with the sprites folder collapsed. Try unfolding a few folders under sprites/: the editor becomes very slow to respond.
4. Leave the editor open. Thumbnails for all 80,000 images are generated in the background, which takes a long time (40–50 minutes with Editor Settings > Interface > Editor > Update Continuously enabled and the editor window in front).
5. Restart the editor and open the project again. Within a few minutes, the Output panel fills with errors and the editor freezes or crashes.

[mrp-filesystem-thumbnails.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32783270/mrp-filesystem-thumbnails.zip)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

The 80,000 images are too big to upload, so the project generates them in step 1.
